h1: Custom 62 Inch Umbrellas for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom 62 inch umbrellas in bulk for your brand. Perfect for corporate gifts and events. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Sixty-two inch umbrellas offer generous coverage for two people, making them ideal for corporate gifts at trade shows or client appreciation events. The larger canopy provides more space for your logo, ensuring high visibility with full-color imprinting on durable polyester fabric. Choose from auto-open or manual styles in a range of colors to match your brand.
heroAltText: Custom 62 inch umbrellas with company logo printed on canopy, available for bulk orders
